race.comment: JACKPOT CHEVY (5) struggled for best form latest, finishing 4th (23.30) in a Grade 5 at The Gardens. Has never missed the frame here at the trip including two wins. Can atone. AL CAN DO (1) doesn't win out of turn. Finished second (17.85) at this track latest and might be close to finding winning form again. Can measure up. GUNNELL GIRL (8) has won at this course and distance so keep her in mind.
